Chapter 10 Lu Daosheng'S Departure

Hearing Old Li's words, a young man with a little longer experience said contemptuously: "Uncle Li, it's not enough to just cultivate to the realm of concentration. With this current environment, I think it's not enough to break through to the realm of the Divine Mansion. consider."

This person's name is Zhang Cheng, and he is the son of Old Man Zhang's house in Lao Zhang's Noodle Restaurant.

Previously, Old Man Zhang spent a huge amount of money to send him out for training for a while, allowing him to gain a long experience.

So Zhang Cheng knew many things that people in the desert city didn’t know, including the Divine Palace Realm, which is much stronger than the Concentration Realm.

Upon hearing this, Old Li's expression collapsed.

"You little brat, you really have gained skills."

Suddenly, everyone burst into laughter.

"Okay, everyone next, just do their best and don't waste these resources."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke slowly.

When everyone heard Lu Daosheng's words, they stopped immediately.

"Just don't worry, the city lord. We finally had such a good opportunity, how could we waste it?"

"Yes, lord, we will never let you down."

Everyone agreed at this time.

Hearing these words, Lu Daosheng nodded and left with satisfaction.

Return to the city lord's mansion.

In an instant, all the people in the city lord's mansion appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Everyone was stunned and when they saw Lu Daosheng, they all bowed one after another.

"City Lord."

Lu Daosheng nodded and looked at Awei.

Since he became the city lord, Awei has been following him and is loyal.

Now, he has reached such a terrifying state as the realm of destiny, and he can see through the hearts of people. He thought there would be one or two uneasy guys in the city lord's mansion.

Unexpectedly, at first glance, they were all loyal.

But I judge a gentleman by the heart of a villain.

"How many years have you been in the City Lord's Mansion?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

Upon hearing this, everyone answered honestly.

"Sixteen years."

"Thirteen years."

"Nine years."

......

"Thirty years."

For thirty years, Lu Daosheng looked at the old man who had answered for thirty years.

His name is Jiang Yuan, and he is the only one who has remained in the lord's mansion since the death of the old city lord.

Lu Daosheng respected him, so he was the butler of the City Lord's Mansion. He worked hard for the City Lord's Mansion over the years, which also made him happy and comfortable on weekdays.

Originally, the old man's lifespan was almost dry.

Now, under such an environment, the elder of the Huangcheng City Lord's Mansion seemed to have lived in the second spring.

It only took a little under the tree of life for a while, and its life span continued to increase.

"Old Jiang, thank you for your hard work over the years."

Lu Daosheng looked at Jiang Yuan and smiled slightly.

Upon hearing this, Old Jiang was a little flattered and hurriedly said, "City Lord, I dare not be a slave."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng just smiled and said nothing.

Next, Lu Daosheng looked at Awei again.

This is his right-hand man, the person he can trust the most besides his relatives.

Now, all the people from the city lord's mansion have to be trained by themselves.

"Next, I will take you to a place where you will have countless opportunities. How much you can gain depends on your own efforts."

Hearing this, everyone nodded.

"Thank you, the city lord, for the opportunity."

They knew that the current city lord was no longer the previous city lord.

Although I don't know what happened, it doesn't matter.

What’s important is that their deserted city is about to develop.

The next moment, everyone disappeared.

Lu Daosheng looked at the people in the world in his palm and smiled with satisfaction.

A person with his strength will definitely be able to open up a world with bare hands.

So Lu Daosheng did not intend to waste this world.

In his own world, everything can be controlled by himself, so Lu Daosheng also arranged many legendary treasures in the system store in the world in his palm.

Nothing worse than in the deserted city.

After all, this is prepared for the confidants, so of course it cannot be too casual.

After preparing these, Lu Daosheng finally took a look at the current deserted city. After confirming that there was nothing missing, he turned around and left.

He wants to build a deserted city, make it the strongest force, and the existence of an eternal giant city.

That person must be missing.

Before, there were not even a hundred people in the wasteland city and the city lord's mansion.

As a supreme force, wouldn’t it be shameless to have no one?

No matter how strong you are, you can't do everything yourself.

So Lu Daosheng decided to go outside and find some potential stocks to cultivate.

This is the purpose of Lu Daosheng leaving the deserted city for a period of time.

At the same time, outside the deserted city.

At this moment, countless cultivators with powerful auras have surrounded the deserted city.

However, no matter how they attacked, no means could break the protective film of the deserted city.

They could only put this layer of protective film to see a vague giant city inside.

It can be seen that the golden light is vaguely prosperous.

"Who can tell me what the hell is going on?"

At this time, an old man in the crowd suddenly shouted.

Hearing this, someone was about to whine, and he immediately felt the breath of the old man's divine palace.

Divine Mansion Realm.

That is the top powerhouse in the Tianxuan world.

You can't afford to offend.

"Senior, we are all new here, and we don't know much about this mysterious city."

At this time, a young man in luxurious clothes said politely.

Hearing this, the old man snorted coldly and said, "Who is the person in charge here? Don't you know about this huge city that appeared out of nowhere?"

Yes, the person in charge here doesn't know yet.

Everyone immediately thought of this and started looking for it.

As the saying goes, there is strength in numbers.

In less than a moment, a somewhat timid middle-aged man was pushed in front of everyone.

Seeing this middle-aged man, the old man frowned slightly.

"You are the person in charge of this area."

That is, the strongest person in this area.

After all, no matter how poor the deserted city is, it will not be a land without an owner.

However, this middle-aged man has only the peak of the Breaking Sky Realm, which makes everyone despise him.

It is indeed a wild land.

The middle-aged man smiled bitterly and said, "Senior, I don't know. There was indeed a city here, named Huangcheng, but it was small and dilapidated, and it was not comparable to the mysterious giant city in front of me. As for the rest, I don't know."

At this moment, everyone present was a cultivator from a big place, and there were many people with higher cultivation than him.

He was arrogant and domineering in Huangzhou on weekdays, but he was trembling with fear at this moment.

As for the mysterious giant city that suddenly appeared in front of him, he didn't know what was going on.

At this moment, someone suddenly exclaimed, "I remember that this mysterious giant city seems to be called Huangcheng!"

Hearing this, everyone immediately recalled it.

Then they were shocked.

The picture of the mysterious giant city appeared in everyone's mind before, and it was known to everyone.

Just a little recollection, and then the two big words on the city gate sounded.

Huangcheng.

And this guy said that there was originally a city called Huangcheng here, so it was hard not to think that the two cities had some connection.

"Could it be that this is a city?!"

"But didn't that guy say that the deserted city was small and dilapidated?"

"Hey, do you remember who the original lord of the deserted city was?"

Hearing this, the middle-aged man was stunned for a moment, then said: "I remember, I remember."

"Oh? Then tell me quickly."

Everyone looked at the middle-aged man.

If we know who the lord of the city is, maybe there will be some clues.

The middle-aged man thought about it for a while and was about to speak, but the next moment, he was stunned.

Who is the lord of the deserted city?

Fuck, why do I suddenly forget it.

At this moment, he was a little horrified. There were only a few cities in his area, and he remembered every lord clearly. Although he only came to this deserted city once every few years, he would never forget the name of the lord of the deserted city.

But now, no matter how he recalled, all the information about the lord of the deserted city in his mind had disappeared.

As for the appearance of the lord of the deserted city, he knew nothing about it.

Seeing the middle-aged man standing there in a daze.

Some people frowned.

"Don't you remember? Are you kidding us?"

Hearing this, the middle-aged man almost knelt on the ground, his face uglier than eating shit.

"Seniors, I, I,..."

"Okay."

At this time, a beautiful woman suddenly spoke.

Everyone looked and saw the beautiful woman's face, and they all exclaimed.

"The owner of Tianyin Island, she is here too!"

Tianyin Island, an island near Huangzhou.

Although it is close to Huangzhou, the resources and wealth on the island are very different from those in Huangzhou.

And Tianyin Island is also one of the most powerful forces in Tianxuan World.

Its owner, Mu Tianyin, has the cultivation of Minghe Realm, standing at the top of the cultivators in Tianxuan World, looking down on the heroes.

He is also the only Minghe Realm powerhouse on the field now.

After all, who can guarantee that there are no other Minghe Realm powerhouses observing in secret.

Seeing the island master of Tianyin Island, Mu Tianyin, everyone saluted.

"We are here to see the island master of Tianyin."

"Senior Tianyin, this guy just said he remembered, but now he is silent. Isn't this obviously playing tricks on us?"

At this time, someone spoke up.

Hearing this, everyone nodded, obviously a little angry.

After all, they came all the way to the deserted state, but they couldn't even get in the door when they arrived.

At this moment, everyone was a little angry.
